"The early graph has disputed pictorial interpretations, including a hanging percussion instrument, a house front, and a covered vessel with a plant-like feature. The received Shuowen analysis divides it into 𣎵 and phonetic 𢆉; 字源 rejects that analysis, and the evidence here does not establish a settled component construction."
"南 is attested for “south” in Shang inscriptions. Its early graph’s depicted object remains disputed, and the received Shuowen component analysis is rejected in a consulted modern reference."

"Oracle-bone, bronze, manuscript, and seal forms are reported; the received dictionary tradition also records 𡴖 as an ancient form. 字源 charts forms from Shang through later scripts and describes graphic changes and confusion with 市-like forms, but these accounts do not establish a continuous derivation from a particular Shang object picture."

"Shang inscriptions report 南 for the direction, in the ancestor name 南庚, and for a sacrificial item. 字源 calls 南 a loan graph for the directional word, attested in Yin oracle-bone inscriptions, but the proposed object’s identity and ancient name and pronunciation remain unresolved; the reported uses do not establish which came first."

"The early graph’s referent remains disputed among an instrument, a house front, a covered vessel, and other proposals. 字源 rejects the received Shuowen component analysis, while the proposed lexical link between “south” and a belly or front-of-body word concerns the spoken word’s history and does not establish the graph’s formation."
"The received Shuowen analysis assigns 𣎵 a semantic role within 南, but 字源 rejects this component analysis; the role remains a disputed historical interpretation."

"The received Shuowen analysis calls 𢆉 phonetic, but 字源 rejects this component analysis. Its current Mandarin reading can be compared with 南 nán, though this does not verify the historical phonetic claim."
"南 means “south,” a use attested in Shang inscriptions. Its early graph has disputed object interpretations; the received Shuowen component account is also disputed."
